changes_made.explanation: Changed task description to better reflect the paper's focus on emotion understanding evaluation rather than generation of empathetic responses. Added more accurate output description.
Normalized metric name to standard capitalization. EU Score is the only automatic metric used for evaluating emotional understanding.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted. The paper only uses LVLMs for generation tasks, not for evaluation.
No human evaluation was conducted. The paper relies solely on automatic evaluation using the EU Score metric.

overall_notes: The paper evaluates Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs) on their ability to understand emotions in dialogues when placed in different environmental contexts. The NLG aspect involves models generating emotional intensity predictions and interpretations. The extracted metadata was generally accurate, with minor normalization needed for consistency. The paper uses a single automatic metric (EU Score) derived from EQ-Bench, with no human or LLM-as-judge evaluations.
